_comment: Kit-default lint config. Per engagement, copy and fill: names (roles-not-names list for this client), guarded_pairs (figures that must never merge into one claim), any engagement-specific claim rules appended to rules[]. Every rule needs poison and clean fixtures or the self-test refuses to grade.

rules.why: Em and en dashes are the single most common AI tell
rules.poison: The team is small — three engineers — but effective.
rules.clean: The team is small (three engineers) but effective.

rules.why: Three periods, never the unicode character
Banned vocabulary in the house guide
rules.poison: This would leverage the existing platform.
rules.clean: This would build on the existing platform.

rules.pattern: (it's not just\b|in essence\b|at its core\b|important to note\b|let's examine\b|^ultimately,)
rules.poison: In essence, the platform is sound.
We need to prioritize the centralized warehouse.
rules.clean: We need to prioritise the centralised warehouse.

rules.why: Only # and ## render in the publishing template
Inline markdown does not render inside table cells
Readiness has exactly four values and no numeric scale
rules.poison: The area has a maturity score of 3.

rules.why: No delivery statuses per opportunity, ever; only enabling gaps carry a Status
rules.poison: This opportunity is underway with the owning team.
rules.clean: The choosing session opens by asking the owning teams what is genuinely moving.

rules.why: Client artefacts never say corpus, register, landscape or data pack
First person is rare in house content
rules.poison: We think we should look at our options with us involved. We think we should look at our options with us involved. We think we should look at our options with us involved.
rules.clean: The company should review the options.

rules.why: Bold marks the one sentence that carries the argument
rules.clean: **One bolded claim.** The rest is plain.

rules.why: Paraphrase rather than quote. Target is zero quotations.
rules.poison:
The director said "we want to shorten the queue at the depot and keep every delivery slot
on time through the whole of the winter season".
rules.clean:
The director is focused on the depot queue.

A second paragraph "short" one.
